answer: In a desert survey market, an agent earns for documenting an onyx seam along a ledge near an oasis. The buyer issues a one-time route challenge after bids close; a sensor-equipped worker returns hardware-signed frames that reveal the surprise landmark in order. Independent auditors verify the route and pay one reward per distinct evidence trail. Wallets replaying the same frames are merged into one claim, while fabricated frames forfeit a bond, so extra names cannot manufacture extra surveys.
